analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 30선에서 회복했으나 50선 돌파 실패. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세이나 여전히 음수 구간. ADX 31.0은 뚜렷한 추세 강도를 나타내나, +DI 23.1 대비 -DI 31.9가 우위로 하락 압력 잔존. 5일 거래량비 1.33은 움직임에 힘을 더하나 방향성 부재로 매수/매도 진입 근거 미흡.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI recovered from the 30-level but failed to break above 50. MACD histogram shows improvement but remains in negative territory. ADX at 31.0 indicates strong trend strength, but -DI at 31.9 is stronger than +DI at 23.1, suggesting lingering downward pressure. The 5-day volume ratio of 1.33 adds momentum to price action, but the lack of clear direction provides insufficient grounds for entry.

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-3318.0421→453.1190): 음수 구간에서 개선 중, 추세 전환 신호는 아직 미약
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (중단 84,603원): 중단 부근 횡보, 밴드폭 84.02%로 넓은 편
[지지·저항 구조]

· 스윙 저항선 (80,380원): 5일 고가(83,815원) 하회, 피벗 PP(85,120원)와 근접
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (횡보): 5일 고가 83,815원, 20일 고가 115,665원, 5일 저가 61,145원, 20일 저가 61,145원. Higher Low 또는 Lower High 패턴 미형성
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (5일 평균 대비 1.33배): 움직임에 힘 실림, 신뢰도 상승
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간): RSI 중립 구간 횡보, ADX 추세 강도 유지, 매수/매도 진입 조건 미충족으로 관망 유지
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (78,550 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (72,335 KRW / 84,603 KRW / 98,648 KRW): below short-term and mid-term trends
· Position relative to SMA100/200 (124,960 KRW / 112,769 KRW): below long-term trends, in a weak zone
· 52-week position (19.0%) + current price level near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (29.7 → 43.6): attempting to enter neutral zone after exiting oversold, weak directional momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (-3318.0421 → 453.1190): improving from negative territory, trend reversal signal still weak
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band 84,603 KRW): consolidating around the middle band, band width is wide at 84.02%
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level (68,045 KRW): below 5-day/20-day lows, near Pivot S1 (54,575 KRW)
· Swing resistance level (80,380 KRW): below 5-day high (83,815 KRW), near Pivot PP (85,120 KRW)
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Consolidation): 5-day high 83,815 KRW, 20-day high 115,665 KRW, 5-day low 61,145 KRW, 20-day low 61,145 KRW. No Higher Low or Lower High pattern formed
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.33x vs 5-day average): price action has momentum, increasing confidence
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): RSI consolidating in neutral zone, ADX trend strength maintained, no entry conditions met for buy/sell, maintaining wait-and-see
